ideas.title: Uncovering the Scope of Minnesota's Medicaid Fraud Problem
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the number of cases, dollar amounts, and entities involved.
questions: What is the total amount of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Which entities are most involved in Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: Understanding the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota can help identify patterns and areas for improvement in the state's healthcare system.
